svg.text: position j: block for rank j
position i: block for rank r + i
position j: block from rank j
Cell ij: the block from rank i for rank j, colored by its source rank. Outlined: the blocks a rank just received in this round.
In round k, every rank sends the blocks at the positions whose bit k is set to rank r + 2ᵏ, which stores them at the same positions.
